messages.text: Are we still doing the little place by the bookstore after your shift?
Yes, but can we sit near the window? I want to compare the Honduras one with the bag I tried at work.
Bring the tiny notebook then lol. I want to see if you write 'chocolate' again.
Only if it actually tastes like that this time.
You went quiet after work. Voice note me before you start spiraling in your head.
I will. Jasmine covered the front for ten minutes so I could breathe, so it is less awful now.
Good. Also Saturday coffee still? I found a cheap open-mic thing after, no pressure.
Coffee yes. Open mic maybe if I am not wiped. Just me, no extra ticket situation.
Mija, you got home? You left your water bottle on the counter this morning.
Home. I know, I only had coffee at work and now my temples feel tight.
Come eat a little soup. No more staring at those bills tonight.
I'm coming. My shoulders are all up from trying to make the paycheck stretch to class fees.
u home before 7? I need help with the history paragraph
After I stop for tortillas and eggs. Put your outline on the table.
can u make the potato tacos too
Only if you rinse the pan and clear the sink first.
Can I move your little table for my history poster or is it still wet over there?
Leave it please. The blue cup has brushes in it and the plant tray is already balancing on one book.
lol okay your window spot is a whole setup
I only need the left half tonight. You can use the floor by the lamp.
When you leave tonight, park closer to the front lights if there is space.
I did. The back rows at Bella Terra get too empty after closing.
Tomorrow I will press the pedal so you can check both brake bulbs again.
Thank you. I don't want a repeat of that Warner Ave night.
Mija, your mom said you stayed late again. Did you eat before closing?
Yes, abuelita. I stayed to copy the seating notes and ask how they count the drawer at the end.
Mija, your tia put the party time in the family group. Did you see it?
Mija, when you come Sunday can you bring the pan from your mom's house? The one we used when you were little in Santa Ana.
Your cousin asked if you can bring the blue dress from my closet for Saturday.
Yes, if my mom hasn't packed it in the garage. She still calls it the Santa Ana pan like we moved yesterday.
Not yet, Abuela. I'll open that app after class. I was looking at the little cafe Daniela saved me and lost track.
Yes, I can stop after class. It still fits better than the one I bought for my ID photo last year.
Good. Learn the little things. And don't spend all your tips on coffee with Daniela.
I put $38 from last night in the tin. The little counter with pan dulce and local paintings is still getting its envelope.
Ay, because that kitchen had all the noise. Your tio shouting in one tongue, your mom answering in the other.
Good. And tell your mama if you are coming home before dinner or only after the class.
Okay. Also your cousin is selling a small table there if your mom still needs one.
I can hear it exactly. Then school felt so quiet after that.
I'll check the sale post too. I'm putting my phone away first so I don't disappear into videos before breakfast.
Mija your cousin sent me a video about that cough going around. Should I send it to the family chat?
Send it to me first please. I want to compare it with the county page before everybody starts passing it around.
Mija, I found your black blouse from Sunday. Do you want me to fix the loose button before your shift?
Yes please, Abuelita. I need that one tonight with the black pants.
Ok. I also saved the tea recipe just in case.
That's fine for comfort, but let me ask Tia Maribel at the office and check the pharmacist note before we tell anyone what to do.
Bring the shoes too if they are hurting. Maybe the little cushion inserts will help.
I put them by the door. I also saved a quick eye thing but I am keeping it small for tonight.
The tiny room behind LibroMobile has a 7:30 list tonight. You still want to try for a chair?
Yes, but only if we swing by that 4th St opening first. The flyer from the mural account said they have prints up until 7.
Deal. I saved the post too. If your shift runs late I can put our names down.
Please. I packed flats so I can go straight there.
Open mic Friday? They have that patio again, but I can ask for inside if the air outside gets weird.
Inside is better. Also I have that CVS thing Saturday morning, so Friday I am doing one tiny cheers and going home early.
Deal. I will not let you get talked into round two, especially before the sore-arm errand.
Thank you. I still need to find my little card before then.
u and mom going to Northgate later?
u coming home soon? they had those guys by the front gate again after lunch
Yeah, after class. Just keep walking with your friends and don't get pulled into hallway drama.
After I drop off Grandma's form. She needs corn husks and chiles before Sunday.
get the pan dulce too pls. dad said the big pot is already on the stove
it makes everyone act weird. even teachers were quiet
I remember that feeling. Send me the flyer your history teacher mentioned too, the one for the Santa Ana poster table.
Only if you clear the table before I get back.
Elena says grab tortillas before you come. Rosa might stay after dinner.
I can stop by Northgate. Is Mateo done with soccer or still there?
Still there. His number 15 jersey is in the dryer, don't forget it.
Got it. I'll bring it and text Lupita about Saturday too.
Mija, your mom said your eyes were watery this morning. I saved you some mint tea.
Gracias grandma. I also need to stop for the soft tissues before class.
Eat a little bread first. No strong coffee by itself, okay?
I know, I already made that mistake with cold brew before breakfast.
Mija, llegaste? Your mom said it was busy tonight.
Just got home. A couple at 14 thought the extra charge was wrong, so I went line by line with them and got them agua while the manager fixed it.
Ay, people get tired when they wait. You did good checking every little thing.
They left smiling after I wrote the parking note for them. The señora said gracias twice, so I think we saved it.
Casa Luna posted the Thursday sheet again. Want me to put us down near the middle instead of the first few?
Middle is better. I can get there after class if we skip dinner out and just grab a small coffee.
Perfect. Patio table after, so we can actually hear each other.
Yes please. I still want to hear the guitar guy from last time if he shows up.
Mija, I put the blue school folder by the microwave. Don't forget your shift starts at 5.
Got it. I'm reading the credit sheet before I leave. Can you save me dinner?
Yes. Eat when you get back. One class at a time, okay?
Okay. I keep seeing the old online semester on there and it makes my stomach drop.
Before you leave, check the tire light. Also ask your mom for the Edison total.
I checked the tires last night. I can send my part after my check hits, before the 2-10.
Ok. Eat first. Don't rush to work.
I won't. Closing is smoother now that I know the drawer and the back room steps.
Mija, your mama said you have the folder day today. Do you need me to save the table quiet for you after dinner?
Yes please. I have to finish the two pages before my 3:30 shift, and my phone keeps yelling at me every hour.
Good. Put tea also, not just coffee. And tell me when that campus lady answers about the missing credits.
I will. I put her call on my list for noon so I don't avoid it.
Mija, did your envelope come already? Mine has too many papers.
Yes, I marked most of it last night after reading the plain-language packet. I can sit with you Sunday and go page by page.
Good. I want to understand the hospital one and the apartments one.
Those are the two I underlined too. I also saved the school funding page because Mateo asked what it changes.
Coffee tomorrow still? I can do 10:30 if you are not already booked.
10:30 works. I might meet Nina at the Laguna Hills studio first if I can spare the drop-in.
Okay, text me after. Same little place by the bookstore?
Yes. If I skip the studio, I may do the park path before coffee instead.
u coming home before tipoff or nah
Yeah, save me the corner spot. Did Dad already take over the remote?
obviously. he put the speaker by the tv too
Tell him not too loud yet, Mom is still in the kitchen.
Mija did you go to the Brookhurst place already? Your mama said temprano.
Yes, done. They just took my blood and gave me the paper for the front desk.
Bueno. And for that back tooth, don't wait until soup only again.
I know. I moved the Beach Blvd appointment to the 19th so it is actually on my calendar now.
Mija, your tio says the party may finish late. If I get too tired, can I sleep on the sofa by the window?
Yes, Abuela. I’ll move Mateo’s backpack and put the blue blanket out before we leave.
Only if it is not trouble. I can go home in the morning after coffee.
No trouble. Mom already said we’ll keep the hallway clear so Dad can leave early.
Crystal Cove before coffee or are your legs still mad from yesterday?
They are complaining but I can do the shorter trail. Coffee after is mandatory.
Deal. I will bring the little sunscreen, you bring the playlist.
Leaving in 20. Wearing the shoes with actual grip this time.
Did you see everyone changing their story background for the city council thing?
Yeah. I'm going to the Saturday table instead. A square on my story feels weird if I don't actually show up.
Send me the real info then, not the messy screenshot one.
I found the LA Times piece and the city page. I'll send those, then we can figure out what shift fits after coffee.
Your tires are good. I left the gauge in the glove box.
Gracias. I'm taking the beach path before work, so I'll check them when I park.
Take water. Sun is already strong.
I have it. Just need the long walk first.
Need air in front left tire. I can do it before dinner.
Thank you. I moved the Kyoto train pass money to the envelope so I am not touching gas money.
Good. Keep emergency cash separate. Cheap room is fine, no skipping food.
I know. I am comparing the hostel by the ceramics street with the one closer to the morning coffee place.
You leaving soon?
Almost. The screen froze while I was closing two pickup tabs, so I had to ask Marco before I cashed out.
Ok. Text your mom when you get in the car.
I will. I already sent her in the house chat because the phone kept ringing right as I was trying to finish.
Mija, if you stop by after the beach, can you bring the little glass candle from my blue bag?
Yes, I am walking now while it is still quiet. I'll come by before breakfast.
Gracias. I put your abuelo's photo on the table already.
I'll bring flowers too if the stand by Warner is open.
You working early tomorrow or closing?
Early. 7:45-3:30, then they have me back Fri/Sat. New sheet only goes through next Tuesday.
Ok. Put gas tonight, Costa Mesa morning traffic gets bad.
I will. If Fri stays 8 hours that puts me right under 31 for this week.
Can u get fries on the way home
Only if you send me your English paragraph first. I already moved most of this check into class stuff and the little trip jar.
bruh what trip jar now
The one that makes me close the Colombia tab before I do anything dumb. Napa tabs can stay open lol.
Mija are you eating before yoga or after? I made rice.
After. Daniela is calling while I drive there, then I might meet Jasmine for tea if she gets out early.
Okay. Tell me when you park. Are you bringing anyone for Sunday dinner?
Just me Sunday. Save me rice please.
Ya llegaste from work? I left rice on the stove. Don't forget tomorrow you said the online room opens at 8.
Home. I moved the reading reminder to 7:15 because I know I'll say later and then crash.
Okay. Proud you put it where you can see it. Same as we talked after that bad night in December, one step written down.
I remember. I don't want to sit with it alone again, so I'm keeping the little boxes checked.
send me that runner stretch vid again pls
The one from the short-video app? I saved it with the yoga one and the chicken rice recipe.
yeah that one. also your makeup clip popped up on my page lol
Don't start. I'm only opening it to copy the link, then phone goes on the kitchen counter.
u leaving soon? bathroom mirror is free
In two minutes. Just smoothing my hair and finding the plain black tee.
the video you sent mom had sparkly stuff lol
That was just for the shape. No sparkle when I have to stand by the entrance all night.
For history hw can I ask why you crossed out that guy on the sample sheet lol
Because his answers on class size, lunch programs, and overtime rules were not it.
So you just pick whoever says the nicer thing?
No, I compare the summary, endorsements from people I trust, and what they already did. Pretty speeches are not enough.
u home after class or still at work
Class first, then closing shift. I'll be home late.
can u look at my history paragraph tomorrow? mom said not to bug u but pls
Tomorrow after dinner. I need to finish my own packet tonight before I sleep.
I left quarters by the microwave. Washer card is low.
Got it. I’ll run towels after Mateo’s practice clothes, then Mom’s uniforms.
Maintenance call got moved to Brookside. I’ll be back before dinner if traffic is normal.
Okay. I’ll check the sink ticket with the office if they open before my class.
Mija, gas is low in the Civic. Fill before you take your abuela tomorrow.
Okay. I'll do it after buying chicken and the green sauce.
Good. Your mom said just make rice with it, nothing extra.
Perfect. I'll wash the rice cooker bowl when I get in.
Dodgers start 7:10. I left your plate on stove.
Almost there. Is Mateo doing homework or pretending?
Pretending. Music is on low until first pitch.
Good, I can eat before he starts yelling at the screen.
Did you finish that campus form or did the boxes make you mad again
I picked the same one I always pick, but it still feels like borrowing somebody else's jacket.
That is exactly the sentence you should put in a poem lol
Maybe. The language question was easier. At least that one sounded like my actual house.
Open mic got moved to 8. Want to do the free gallery first and split one latte?
Yes. I brought the little notebook from Antigua. The mural sketches still match half the colors I keep saving for the apron idea.
The coffee farm page with the pressed flower? Bring that one. It always makes you pick better color combos.
I will. Also no bookstore spending tonight, I already put $12 into the next-trip jar.
Mija can you stop for tortillas, chicken, and soap after class? I put the list on the fridge.
Yes. I left $75 in the blue envelope too. Use it for the cart or the water one, whatever is due first.
Gracias. Come straight home after work tonight, okay?
I close at 9:30. I like knowing the night goes easier when I stay on top of everything.
Mija, are you eating before it gets busy?
I had rice in the back. Now I'm moving the 6:30 party because bussers need five more minutes on the big table.
Ok breathe poquito. Message me if it gets too much.
Thank you. I put a note in the book and changed it on the iPad so the servers don't get surprised.
Mija, Daniela left the extra flyers on the kitchen table. Do you want them in your backpack?
Yes please, just the small stack. I'm giving a few to people after class.
Okay. Eat before you go. Also Mateo said his school had a line at the side gate today, like when you were there.
Ugh, that old stomach drop. Tell him he can text me if he wants a ride or just to vent.
Are you and Daniela still going to that tiny stage thing tonight or can u bring popcorn for the movie?
Tiny stage first, movie after if I am not sleepy. I can bring the microwave box from home.
Dad says game will be on too. Don't buy the theater popcorn, it's a scam lol
Not buying it. We are doing couch movie or beach air after, depending how late it runs.
u home yet? mom asked
Not yet, waiting for the couple from bakery to walk out so I'm not crossing the lot by myself.
smart. also dad said tap brakes when u pull in so he can see if the left one is fixed
Okay. Fountain Valley is easy for errands, but nights like this make me rush to the car.
I put air in your tires. Take the blue bottle from the garage, your small one is empty.
Thank you. I was rushing and already doing the jaw-clench thing thinking about being late.
Leave now. Parking by school gets bad.
Going. I'll drink on the way so I don't get that forehead pressure by class.
Mija, tu mama said you are going to Santa Ana after work. Is it late?
Not too late. They have posters and a circle about the courthouse families, then I can bring you the pan dulce from Northgate.
Ok. Take a sweater. Those talks can feel heavy, but pictures help people listen.
That is why I wanted to go. I will text when I leave.
Mija, your arm better from Saturday? I made caldo if you come by.
Much better, just heavy that day. I am coming after class, and I will bring the pan dulce you like.
Good. And at Tia's tonight, stay by me if the backyard air bothers you.
I will. I am only staying for food and one toast anyway.
Beach walk or are you still doing the dramatic ankle-wrap era?
Walk is fine. No jumping for me after last summer's sand volleyball lesson lol.
Also please tell me you didn't cancel the mouth x-ray thing again.
Still going Thursday. I already did the regular clinic stuff this month, so I have no excuse.
Mija, can you check if Rosa's tea tin is in the pantry before we leave?
Yes. Also Lupita said she can meet us after her shift, around 2.
Good. Mateo wants you to look at his history paragraph tonight.
I will. Tell Raul I'll move my car so he can get the ladder out.
Can you grab bananas when you come back? Coach said cramps are from me eating trash lol
I can. I am near the beach courts so give me like 25.
Did you actually play or just stand there pretending
Rude. I got sand everywhere and one decent serve, so yes.
u taking the small room back or is grandma sleeping there tonight
Mine. Rosa is going home after the party. Don't throw your cleats in there again.
ok ok. also can u ask mom if your 2005 folder has my birth cert copy too
I'll check the drawer after I change out of this dress.
u home or still at that cafe?
Still here. Daniela is finishing her drink and I'm adding the last notes before we leave.
notes for a drink is crazy
You write three paragraphs about soccer highlights. Let me have this.
Car has air now. Also check your oil this week.
Thank you. I picked up an extra shift Sunday, so gas and oil are covered without touching the envelope.
Good. You said work had you making the table map tonight?
Only practice, but I want to get fast at it. I saved the clean copy next to my pastry-price notes.
Mija, your mom found a folder from when you were little. Many pages with cups, flowers, and windows.
Please save it for me. I want to put one by my table with the pothos.
I kept the one with the tiny restaurant chairs. You always noticed everything.
Mija, can you taste the mole when you wake up? I think it needs a little more chocolate.
Yes, but don't let Mateo steal tortillas before I get there.
Too late. I saved enough. Rosa said she is coming early so we should set her chair by the window.
u still taking me to practice or nah
I can, just give me 20. My eyes are doing that watery thing again and I need to find my sunglasses.
also dad made coffee and it is strong strong
Do not let me drink that before I eat. Put a tortilla on the comal please.
Tires are good. If you drive to the cliffs this early, text when you park.
Parked. I wanted a few minutes with the sunrise before everyone wakes up.
Your mom left matches by the stove for the candle later.
Thanks, Dad. I'll be back in time to help her set the small table.
Car okay? You got out late.
Car is fine. We had a lobby full after the kitchen backed up. I kept checking names so nobody felt skipped.
Good. People notice when you remember them.
One family was upset until I explained the ticket mix-up to the abuelito and then to the son. After that they waited by the window instead of leaving.
Mija, your mama said you are coming after church. Do not buy too much food today.
I won't, Grandma. I'm doing the Sunday list with cash because my card is at $472 and I want it lower before the next check.
Good. Bring the folder with the pretty vineyard picture so I can see.
Okay. That's the close one. The Colombia pictures are staying in the big someday folder.
Mija, can you take me Thursday morning if I ask early?
I can check. They posted Wed-Mon already, and Thursday I am there 9:00-4:00.
Then no, after you rest. Eat something there, not only coffee.
I get a plate on break if the line calms down. I can do Friday before noon maybe.
Mija, your mom said you got home very quiet.
I'm okay. Going around the park once before dinner.
Good, the air is nice today. Bring a sweater when the sun goes down.
I will. The loop usually helps me come back normal.
Mija, are you leaving now? I put your water bottle by the door.
Gracias. I am going toward Peters Canyon with Tara, then I will grab tortillas on the way back.
Okay, be careful. Text me when you are back near the car.
I will. Should be back before the grocery list turns into a whole mission.
Can I use this clip for class? It's from someone's TikTok but it has a news logo in the corner
Find the original article first. Try NPR or the LA Times, then cite that instead of the clip.
Bruh that's more work
Exactly. Also don't just add the graphic and call it done. Put two sentences on what changed or what people can actually do.
Did you see the downtown gallery posted the student night?
Yes, saved it. Same app where I found that brunch place with the blue tiles.
Perfect. Send me the place too, I need cheap dinner ideas.
Sent both. I had to close it after because three running clips turned into twenty.
Mija, do you need me to mail that envelope tomorrow? You close late again.
I dropped it already before work. I kept the sticker in my wallet like last time.
Okay. Your tia was asking what you looked at for the judges and the clinic measure.
I used the county pages, the plain summary, and Daniela's aunt's notes. The clinic one mattered more to me than the mailers made it sound.
Mija can you grab lettuce and the small tortillas? I am leaving late.
Yes. I'll make quesadillas when I get back so Mateo eats before practice.
Gracias. Also put the plates from breakfast in the washer please.
I'll start it before the pan gets hot.
Can Luis crash after the cousin thing tomorrow or is mom gonna say no
Ask her, but probably no unless the adults are still here late. We only have the sofa and the floor mattress.
Bruh ok. I’ll tell him not to bring his Xbox then.
Please. Also clear your school stuff from the living room before Dad gets home.
Car has gas. Tires ok. You still going to that office before work?
Yes, 8:30. It is just the first paperwork visit, then I go straight to the hotel.
Park in front. Text me when done.
I will. No cafe stop after, just coffee, and I am skipping anything extra tonight.
Your black flats are by the washer. I glued the edge again.
Thank you. I need those more than the cute ones for tonight.
Take the little brush from the car. Shirt had lint yesterday.
Good call. I am doing the quick clip I saved but keeping everything clean-looking.
Did you post the little set from Alta or are you hoarding them again?
Posted 5 slides. The counter, your latte, the red chairs, and the messy blue one from my desk.
The red chairs one is my fave. It looks like our corner table but softer.
That one took forever because I kept stopping to mist the fern and reheat my coffee.
When you take Mateo to the library, remind him not to answer the front desk so fast. Let them finish.
I know. They hear his accent on certain words and suddenly explain everything twice.
Si, and he gets embarrassed. You know how to help him without making it bigger.
I'll go with him. I remember being little in Fountain Valley and changing how I talked depending who was listening.
Can u help with my history thing after dinner
u still taking me to practice or did adult school eat ur whole day
Yes, after I redo tomorrow's waitlist sheet. I messed up one note and want it clean.
I can take you. I just need ten minutes because I skipped lunch water and my neck feels like a rock.
You're always making fake restaurant papers now lol
mom said stop doing calculator face at the table lol
u home before 6? need help w english packet
Not fake. Practice. Also my no-spend days bought the used espresso book, so don't clown me.
Tell her I'm done. Rent, gas, and your cleats were all arguing on one screen.
After I take Rosa back from her appointment. Leave it on the kitchen table.
ok. also Elena said Lupita is coming sunday and Raul wants the game on
Then finish your 15 vocab cards before everyone gets loud.
u done yet? mom said ask if you can bring chips
Not yet. I have a line at the door and the kitchen just told me to pause big walk-ins for ten.
rip. send me when ur coming and i'll open the garage
Thanks. I need to enter one more card on the register and fix a name on the list, then I'm out.
Car has gas. Be back by 10, I need it for Home Depot.
Okay. I just need it for coffee with Daniela and the mall return.
Keep your ID with you. The old photo makes you look too young.
I know, I am replacing it before next spring anyway.
I am near the shop on Adams. Need anything before I come home?
If they still have the Guji bag, can you send a picture of the label? I forgot the roast date.
This one? Red sticker, says peach and jasmine.
That's it. I want to match it with what I wrote after the sample at work.
Car has gas. If you go to Santa Ana, park on 3rd, not behind the building.
Thanks, Dad. I'm only helping sort chairs and water bottles for an hour.
Good. Leave if it gets crowded by the front. You never liked that feeling since high school.
I know. I'll stay by the side tables with Daniela and send you a text when I'm heading home.
Mija, tomorrow do not let your mamá rush the sauce. Tell her I can come at noon.
I'll tell her. Do you want me to save the end seat again?
Yes please. And put some without too much chile for your brother.
Mija, after church dinner can you take me home? Your tio is going the other way.
Got it. I'll label the small container before everyone grabs plates.
Yes, I'll drive. It's faster than asking everyone to make extra stops.
Gracias. We leave before it gets too late, okay?
Yes. I don't like being the last car in those big lots, especially since the brake-light night.
Antes de tu turno eat something. Sunday crowd gets impatient.
I packed rice. Also wrote the specials both ways on my pad because yesterday I had to repeat the soup ingredients like six times.
Good. Smile, slow voice, look at the older ones when you explain.
I will. If the entrance piles up again, I’m putting kids near the side bench first and giving real wait times, not guessing.
Car has yellow powder all over again. I rinsed the windshield.
Thanks, Dad. That explains why I used half the tissue pack driving home.
You ate already?
Toast first, coffee after. I learned.
Coffee after your class Thursday? I can bring my laptop and we can sit by the outlets.
Yes please. I have to fix the 2020 login mess and then get to work by 7.
We'll do it in pieces. Same as before, but with better snacks.
Thanks. Mom keeps saying not to let one bad year decide everything.
Coffee Friday or are you doing another late shift?
Late shift. I picked it because the Friday check lines up with groceries and the SDG&E piece.
You sound way less stressed about those shifts than before.
Yeah. Once I stopped treating it like just hours to survive, I actually got good at it.
Mija, your aunt says the office is getting calls about that fever post. She said people are confused.
Can she send me the clinic handout? I saw an NPR update too, but I want the actual instructions before I put anything in the group chat.
Si. And do not argue with your cousin in comments before work please.
I won't. I'll send the handout and county link, then ask who can drive Grandma if she needs it.
Your mom asked if you saw the church event page for Sunday.
I saw the invite there. I don't check that one unless family posts something or someone lists furniture.
Good. Also don't forget tire light if it comes back.
Thanks Dad. And I missed whatever people were arguing about on the black-icon timeline, so that app can stay closed.
Did you try that soft brown lip thing from my For You page or was it a no?
Tried it after class. Cute, but for work I wiped half off and did clear gloss.
Classic you. Black shirt, hair pinned, shoes that survive the whole night.
Exactly. I can play with it when we get coffee tomorrow.
Saturday options: Bolsa Chica walk before sunset, $6 matinee at Starlight, or that gallery room in Santa Ana.
Walk plus matinee sounds good. Gallery if we still have energy.
Open mic starts at 7 but I can meet at Hidden House at 6 if you want your pre-show ritual.
6 works. I want to retry their espresso because last time I wrote sour but I think it was just too hot.
Cool. Also Casa Luna said the next list starts early because there are too many sign-ups now.
Then we should get there earlier next time and sit somewhere we can talk after.
You and your temperature detective work. I'll save us the corner table.
Movie or beach steps tonight? You sounded done in that voice note.
Coffee tomorrow or are you hiding with your spreadsheets again?
Beach steps. If I sit in a theater right now I'll just stew.
Coffee yes, cheap one. I did the after-paycheck boxes already: car surprise, class fee, and the two trip lines.
I'll grab cheap coffee and meet you by the pier stairs.
Two trip lines is very you. Which one gets the tiny victory this week?
Perfect. March being warm at night is carrying me.
Napa gets the book-soon money. Colombia gets the little 'do not touch this unless you're serious' money.
My aunt said the invite card only has one seat under your name. Is that okay?
Yeah, one seat is fine. I'm going with my mom after she gets off work.
Voice note later? My cousin asked about the Broadway thing and I don't want to explain it messy.
Yeah, call me after dinner. I can send you the two slides Monica posted too.
Perfect. Bring the silver clips, they looked cute with the dress.
Also proud of you for staying the whole circle even with that front-door setup.
Barely lol. I kept thinking of the old quad mornings, but the table crew was calm.
I will. Also remind me not to lose my ID again before my next birthday chaos.
Your meme count was low today, should I be concerned or are you just busy?
